lines.trans: I still cannot get over it, Andrea.
You cannot get over what?
That you will soon be a mom!
Me neither, it is a big surprise.
Can I ask you a quick question?
Yes, tell me what you want to know.
A friend would also like to have a child.
And she is looking for practical advice?
Did you use an anonymous donor?

words.gloss: appeal; faire appel à = call upon

lines.trans: That is a particularly indiscreet question, Gabriel!
Sorry, I simply wanted to do a favor.

words.gloss: favor; rendre service = to do a favor

lines.trans: My private life concerns nobody else.
You are completely right, excuse me.

words.gloss: reason; avoir raison = to be right

lines.trans: Let us stay focused on our work at the agency.

words.gram: past participle used as adjective, masculine plural

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens

before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

tag at the end of a question

pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end

alone, in surprise or when you didn't hear; a bit blunt

before the verb; t' before a vowel

plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous

place: à Paris, à mon cours
